description.en: The ID of the instance to which the topic belongs.

description.zh:
待创建主题的名称，用于标识主题，全局唯一。

取值规范如下：

- 字符限制：支持字母a\~z或A\~Z、数字0~9以及下划线（_）、短划线（-）。
- 长度限制：1~60个字符。

保留字符限制，请参见[参数限制](~~440347~~)。
description.en:
The name of the topic to create. The name identifies the topic and must be globally unique.

The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name can contain letters (a-z and A-Z), digits (0-9), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length.

For information about reserved characters, see [Parameter limits](~~440347~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rocketmq create-topic --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --topic-name topic_test --message-type NORMAL --remark This_is_the_remark_for_test. --max-send-tps 1500 --lite-topic-expiration 60 --region cn-hangzhou
